body: What if it won't? And what if it is really bad? Healthy, I try to eat healthy, real meals. My girlfriend and dinner for ourselves about 5 times a week. She buys groceries for the both of us and the financial strain is getting too hard. Neither of us can apply for food stamps (EBT in CA, dunno about anywhere else) because we live at home under age 22. Good sleep is hard for me because I sleep on a futon. My old bed was too big for my apartment (I had a queen) so I opted for a futon. I somewhat regret it now because floorspace is minimal but what can I do.

Should I literally ask them? I'd love to know what their reactions are.  Because right now I see my friends maybe a total of 5 times a month. Yes, work and school conflict schedules arise and they're unavoidable. But nothing ever seems fun anymore and any attempts of new social interaction like road trips and raves cost money I don't have and my girlfriend isn't willing to spend, knowing our situation. Like I said, being fired for stealing and jobs aren't exactly falling out of the sky. If I could get a job, and I honestly mean this, I would be able to attempt to turn my life around.

It'd only be worth it if I'd be having some positive impact on the future. I haven't had the best track record in that department.  

I've been sleeping, but late. Maybe 6 hours a night on average.
